p.title: v59.94 Taiwan monthly revenue erased a company the source rows left out
p.symptom: When a TWSE t187ap05_L run omitted some of the 16 AI supply-chain codes, tw-monthly-revenue.json was still published as status ok with only the present companies; the omitted companies' records and up to 24 months of accumulated history were erased, and a returning code restarted from 3 months.
p.root_cause: buildTwMonthlyRevenue skipped any code without a parsable row and never consulted the previous artifact's record for it, so a missing input became a silent loss.
p.fix: A code missing from this run's rows keeps its previous record (own month and history) marked carried: true and is still listed in missing; a parsed company never carries the flag; status and latestMonth/publishedAt come only from this run's parsed rows, so an all-carried run stays no-companies and leaves the artifact untouched.
p.violated_rule: A missing value stays missing and a value that exists is not thrown away.
p.prevention: ci-tw-monthly-revenue-fixture covers a carried company (equal to its previous record plus carried), the parsed company's 13-month history, latestMonth from the parsed month, the view excluding the older carried month, re-carry comparing unchanged, a returning company dropping the flag, and an all-carried run returning no-companies.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-tw-monthly-revenue-fixture.mjs passes; the new cases fail against the previous producer.

changelog: **Taiwan revenue keeps a company the source left out ({P}):** a code missing from a TWSE run now keeps its previous record and history marked carried, instead of being erased while the artifact still read ok.
note: v59.94: TW revenue carries missing companies
